Here's the straight answer, Fredy. Your replacement NerdOctaxe is still sitting unshipped because the warehouse is waiting on stock for that unit, and there's no confirmed ship date on it right now. I'm not going to invent one.

The team is offline until tomorrow at 10am ET and they'll come back to you with the date by email.

If you'd rather not wait on stock, I can swap it to an in-stock unit at no cost to you. Want me to look at what's shipping now?
Yes, please tell me what you have available

Here's what's actually on the shelf in the US right now, Fredy.

Hammer Miner Thor P2, 10 TH/s, $369, in stock, ships within 2 business days. Closest match to your Octaxe and it goes out almost immediately.

Hammer Miner BC04, 6 TH/s, $239, in stock, ships within 2 business days.

If you'd rather trade up and wait, the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is a pre-order that ships by Nov 21.

Which one do you want me to price out?
If I decide to go for the Hammer Miner Thor P2, what happen with the price diference ?

Nothing for you to pay, Fredy. The T. P2 lists $369 against the $399.99 Octaxe, so there's nothing owed either way.

This order is your warranty replacement at zero cost, so there's no money on it to pay back a difference from. The swap is even, you just get a different unit, same order number, shipping within 2 business days once I make the change.

Want me to do it?

You're right, and I should have said it plainer. You paid $459.49 on the original order for the 12 TH/s unit. The T. P2 is 10 TH/s at $369, so that's a step down, not an even trade.

Two ways to go. Wait for the Octaxe, the team confirms its date tomorrow at 10am ET. Or take the Thor P2 now and I'll have the team settle the difference back to you.

Which do you want?

Understood, I'll leave the Octaxe on the order. The team picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET and the ship date comes to your email, along with tracking the moment it's labelled.

And for the wait on a replacement you shouldn't have needed, I've made you a code for your next order, HD-••••••, $25 off, yours alone, works on orders over $100.

Worth whitelisting us so the mail doesn't land in spam. Anything else I can check?

Happy to help, Fredy. The team has it and the date comes to your inbox.
